_meta.indication: For the treatment of patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer, symptomatic bone metastases and no known visceral metastatic disease

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, international phase 3 trial; patients randomized 2:1 to radium-223 plus best standard of care or placebo plus best standard of care
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer with symptomatic bone metastases; patients with visceral metastatic disease were excluded
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall survival (OS), with one pre-specified interim analysis; key secondary endpoint time to first symptomatic skeletal event (SSE)
pivotal_trials.n: N=921 at the updated analysis (Ra-223 614, placebo 307); 809 randomized at the primary interim analysis (Ra-223 541, placebo 268)
pivotal_trials.result: Interim analysis: median OS 14.0 vs 11.2 months (HR 0.695, 95% CI 0.552, 0.875; p=0.00185). Updated analysis: median OS 14.9 vs 11.3 months (HR 0.695, 95% CI 0.581, 0.832).

nct_ctgov.title: A Phase III Study of Radium-223 Dichloride in Patients With Symptomatic Hormone Refractory Prostate Cancer With Skeletal Metastases

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=10%) were nausea (36%), diarrhea (25%), vomiting (19%), and peripheral edema (13%). Most common hematologic laboratory abnormalities were anemia (93%), lymphocytopenia (72%), leukopenia (35%), thrombocytopenia (31%), and neutropenia (18%).
target_moa: Alpha particle-emitting radium-223 mimics calcium and complexes with bone mineral hydroxyapatite at areas of increased bone turnover such as bone metastases; the high linear energy transfer of alpha emitters causes double-strand DNA breaks in adjacent cells

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it showed improvement in overall survival and did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues

basis.text: NDA given expedited review with a priority review PDUFA date of 8/14/13

citations.quote: This NDA for Xofigo Injection (radium Ra-223 dichloride) was submitted on 12/14/12 and was given an expedited review. The PDUFA date for a priority review is 8/14/13.

summary.text: Xofigo received a traditional (full) approval under a priority review based on the phase 3 BC1-06 (ALSYMPCA) trial demonstrating a statistically significant improvement in overall survival; the application was not referred to an advisory committee, and post-marketing safety and dose-optimization studies were required/committed.

citations.quote: The approval was based on a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 clinical trial demonstrating a statistically significant improvement in overall survival.
This NDA for Xofigo Injection (radium Ra-223 dichloride) was submitted on 12/14/12 and was given an expedited review. The PDUFA date for a priority review is 8/14/13.

The application for Xofigo® (radium Ra 223 dichloride) Injection was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application showed improvement in overall survival and did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues.
